messages:
alexa_sales: Hey team — running a POC with Northpoint Bank next week. They have a few blockers we need to confirm before the exec sign-off: SSO (SAML 2.0), SCIM provisioning at scale (~200k users), RBAC/group mapping, and domain control (multiple org domains). Also they asked whether a Dedicated deployment is required for data residency. Can SEs + security weigh in?

ivan_se: Quick notes from the demo: they want the user->role mapping to be handled via SCIM groups (ok), plus support for role hierarchy. They asked about delegated admin provisioning for SSO admins.

maria_sec: Security checklist incoming — for Private/Dedicated they expect KMS integration, SOC2 type II, quarterly pen test reports, and audit logs with retained events for 2 years. Also need certificate rotation policy for SAML IdP metadata.

ben_devops: For the Dedicated option the VPC appliance supports customer-managed KMS (we support AWS KMS and Azure KeyVault). Ops-wise we can enable audit forwarding to their SIEM via syslog/HTTPS.

oliver_pricing: Pricing question — they asked how committed QPS / reserved GPU sizing maps to discounts. If they commit to a monthly reserved pool for inference (e.g., 2x A100 equivalent), we can propose a 25% discount vs on-demand. Need to confirm expected concurrency and avg tokens/sec.

kate_sme: SCIM details: we support bulk imports and delta syncs. For 200k users we recommend initial bulk sync + incremental deltas every 5 minutes. Our SCIM rate limits default to 20req/s, but for Dedicated we can bump that to 200req/s with a config change. Also SCIM supports externalId mapping, group->role mapping, and custom attribute templates.

alexa_sales: @kate_sme — can you provide the exact SCIM endpoints and an example payload they can show their IdP team? They want to pre-validate their Okta mapping.

kate_sme: Sure — paste below (example):

```
POST /scim/v2/Users
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "jdoe@northpoint.com",
  "externalId": "okta-12345",
  "name": {"givenName": "John", "familyName": "Doe"},
  "emails": [{"value": "jdoe@northpoint.com", "primary": true}],
  "groups": [{"value": "finance-admins", "display": "Finance Admins"}]
}
```

kate_sme: For group sync we return groups via /scim/v2/Groups and we include members as reference URIs. If they need role hierarchy, we'll accept a custom attribute like 'x-redwood-role-level'.

alice_ops: Domain control: we support TXT verification on multiple domains. Example verification token: `_redwood-verification=NPB-abc123`. They asked about wildcard domains — we handle per-FQDN verification, not wildcard. Also we can sign outbound emails from a customer-owned DKIM if they provide key access in Dedicated.

maria_sec: One potential blocker: their legal team insists on explicit tenant isolation and cannot accept multi-tenant hosted for production PII workloads. They'll request a contract addendum for data residency and deletion SLAs. Need legal + sales to flag.

oliver_pricing: Noted. If they require Dedicated + private control plane + custom KMS, that's enterprise pricing. I'll sketch a ballpark: base Dedicated starting at $35k/mo for the reserved pool, plus onboarding/entitlements fee. Final price after usage profile.

ivan_se: Tech POC items we need to deliver this week: 1) SCIM example payload + Okta mapping doc (kate), 2) SAML metadata + cert rotation notes (maria), 3) Dedicated sizing suggestion based on expected QPS/tokens (ben/oliver), 4) Domain verification steps (alice). Can we put dates?

alexa_sales: Suggested timeline: send docs today, schedule IdP dry-run Wed 10am PT, start initial bulk SCIM import Thu. Can engineering be available for the Wed dry-run?

bob_idp_bot: Automated test results: previous Okta dry-run templates passed schema validation 87% of the time. Recommend validating attribute mapping beforehand.

kate_sme: Docs uploaded to the shared drive: https://redwood.app/drive/northpoint/poc-scim-okta (placeholder link). I'll compile mapping and rate-limit guidance.

maria_sec: I'll draft the security one-pager with KMS options, audit log retention, and cert rotation cadence (rotate every 90 days recommended).

ben_devops: I'll run a quick capacity calc if @alexa_sales can provide expected peak active users and avg input tokens per minute. We can show two options: Hosted with regional failover vs Dedicated single-tenant.

alexa_sales: I'll collect numbers from the buyer and post them here by EOD. One more legal ask they mentioned: domain proofing needs to support DNS TXT token rotation — they want to rotate verification tokens quarterly. Is that supported?

alice_ops: Yes — we support re-issuing tokens; verification is idempotent. We log each verification event in audit.

maria_sec: For questionnaire: send us their security questionnaire PDF and we'll pre-fill the standard answers (SOC2, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, key rotation, RBAC audit). If there are custom controls, we'll escalate.

alexa_sales: Thanks — attaching the SQ now (link): https://redwood.app/drive/northpoint/security-questionnaire.pdf

ivan_se: Last thing — they want fallback behavior if SCIM sync fails (e.g., IdP down). We should confirm we don't auto-delete on transient errors and that provisioning has a tombstone + retry window.

kate_sme: Confirmed: we mark failures, run exponential backoff, and never auto-delete active users without an explicit delete event. We do support a 'soft-delete' flag for deprovisioned accounts pending manual review.

oliver_pricing: I'll prepare a draft SOW + pricing deck for Monday with two options: Hosted with enterprise commitments vs Dedicated with KMS + SIEM integration.

alexa_sales: Great — big thanks. If we can get the SCIM + SAML artifacts and the security one-pager today, I'll lock the Wed dry-run. :thumbsup:

kate_sme: Will do.

maria_sec: On it.

alice_ops: Available for Wed.

ben_devops: Available Wed as well.

oliver_pricing: I'll circulate the pricing rubric by EOD Monday.

alexa_sales: Closing thread for now — will reopen after buyer provides concurrency numbers.
